objective: Make Quest v2 deadlines operational without manual intervention: an idempotent server-side scheduler emits reminder notifications and terminal expiry through the existing append-only action gate, the PWA truthfully distinguishes overdue from active while convergence is pending, and standards-based Web Push can notify an opted-in installed PWA when it is closed.

roles_before.artifact: Ron OS and claim-specific live owners own real-world facts; System quest state remains derived.
Neon system_events is the sole mutable owner for quest lifecycle and in-app notification state.
system_apply_action(...) and store.applyAction(...) are the only paths for validated append-only gameplay mutations.
Quest v2 deadlines project from quest.created but currently have no autonomous evaluator.
Exact action retries replay and conflicting idempotency-key reuse is rejected, including across replicas.
The PWA polls the authoritative snapshot and renders visible quests and ledger-backed notifications.
notification.push currently creates in-app ledger state only; there is no closed-PWA delivery channel.
ChatGPT remains the sole intended interactive controller; automation may perform only deterministic policy actions.
Progression remains gated by verified completion; failure never invents evidence or awards value.
Existing Quest v1/v2 events, snapshot reconstruction, LifeUp bridge evidence, and old PWA behavior remain recoverable.
Candidate development cannot silently mutate production schema/player state; promotion requires an exact reviewed authorization.

role_dispositions.destination: Scheduler uses only ledger-owned deadline/lifecycle data and never asserts real-world completion.
Reminder and expiry facts remain append-only system_events; push subscriptions are delivery infrastructure only and cannot alter player projection.
Every automatic reminder/expiry action uses store.applyAction and deterministic idempotency keys.
A startup sweep plus bounded recurring scheduler evaluates UTC deadlines and reminder thresholds, converging overdue ACTIVE quests to EXPIRED.
Quest/deadline/threshold-derived keys prevent duplicate events across ticks, restarts, and replicas.
PWA continues to render snapshot truth and additionally labels locally detected overdue ACTIVE quests as OVERDUE until the ledger converges.
Ledger notifications remain canonical in-app state; optional Web Push fans out only after a newly committed notification and stores only browser delivery subscriptions.
Automation is limited to versioned deterministic reminder/expiry policy; semantic quest creation/recovery remains controller-owned.
Expiry yields no reward and terminal-state validation continues to block completion/progression.
No historical events are rewritten; disabling scheduler/push restores prior runtime while all events remain reconstructable.
Candidate branch and CI are non-production; main promotion/deployment remains separately gated.

capability_probes.assertion: Authorized HTTP/ChatGPT quest actions, snapshot reads, and in-app notification actions retain their behavior.
Repeated/concurrent/startup sweeps cannot create duplicate reminders or expiry events.
Completed, cancelled, failed, or expired quests never receive automated lifecycle writes.
Profile, skills, achievements, rewards, shop, and evidence gates remain unchanged.
Quest and notification state rebuilds from system_events alone; deleting push subscriptions affects delivery only.
